items.title: Rev 2 · "Marked by" on the marked creature, and "Marks · by you" on the one who placed them
items.do: Aveline Judges the Orc Warrior and Durgan Taunts it (his Taunt, or Taunted by Durgan from the Token HUD). Select the Orc Warrior and open the HUD's Situational tab; click the ✕ on one row (Judged or Taunted). Then put both back, select Aveline (or Durgan) and click the ✕ on the orc's row in "Marks · by you"; then select the Orc Warrior again. Last, click "Apply effect" on Judge's card with the orc targeted, then with nothing targeted.
items.expect: The Orc Warrior's Situational tab shows "Marked by" (others · 2): "Aveline · Judged" and "Durgan · Taunted", each with a ✕ at the row's right end; it folds on its title like Hiding, on its own, and its buttons never move. Its ✕ removes that one and posts the same short system line as the "by you" side ("Orc Warrior is no longer Judged by Aveline (removed by hand)" / "... no longer Taunted (from Durgan; removed by hand)"); the mark also leaves Aveline's (or Durgan's) "Marks · by you" entry, and the Judged ring goes. The other way round: a ✕ in Aveline's (or Durgan's) "by you" entry removes the row from the orc's "Marked by". A creature that both placed and carries marks shows both entries, "Marks · by you" first. A player who doesn't own the creature that placed the mark can still remove it from the creature they own (the GM's client does it). Apply effect marks the targeted orc again; with nothing targeted it marks the card's own target.
